Periodic Review Is Now Overdue – Reminder 2
Hi,
Dear {!Contact.FirstName} {!Contact.LastName},
Thank you for being part of the ila family,
To further enhance your banking experience with us and as per instructions from the Central Bank of Bahrain, we are required to complete a review of the information we have on our customers periodically.
As we informed you via email on TODAY(), your account was due for review on . This could be because the last review of your account was completed years ago or because one or more of your documents expired on .
IMPORTANT: We can update your information using the services offered by the Benefit Company if you give your consent to us to access your information with iGA. You can use our app to provide your consent - .
You can instead visit our Service Center at Diplomatic Area during office hours to submit the following documents so that we can update your profile.
Required Documents: (all documents required OR list of expired documents).

Doc 2, etc.
To ease the process and make this effortless for you, please arrange to provide your consent before days from the date of this email.
